name: fxr_yakra_scene
doc: Stands in for the state behind saves/field_re/yakra_defeat_039.state (the owner's F5 snapshot in loc 0C6, Crono, Lucca and Frog, before the Chancellor becomes Yakra): the playthrough's leg 26 cut at 7712 frames -- into 0C6 (f7284), up the aisle until the Chancellor's scene takes control (f7556), its first box read and closed (f7702), the next not yet open: a moment with no box up, which a CtScene snapshot carries whole (the host's typewriter is not in it).
